label: Mine tailings
essentiality_justification: Structurally, no single source of copper is essential.
evidence_justification: Kvassnes & Iversen (2013) reports "~1 million tonnes over 7 years"

label: Fjord sediment
essentiality_justification: Sediment's constituents (organic matter, minerals) contain copper, and though some (bioavailable) copper sediments out into lower strata, there is no evidence nor claims that copper is removed from sediment, or that benthic sediment does not contain copper.
plausibility_justification: Copper occurrence in sediment is consensus and uncontroversial.
evidence_justification: Rich, internally consistent data from multiple sources in multiple locations over long time periods.

label: Fjord water
essentiality_justification: Copper is transported in dissolved form in the water column
plausibility_justification: Copper occurrence in coastal water is consensus and uncontroversial.
evidence_justification: Rich, internally consistent data from multiple sources in multiple locations over long time periods.

label: Mussel soft tissue
essentiality_justification: Soft tissue represents the entirety of mussels' metabolically active tissue. If mussels interact with copper in sea water (even to remove it), this must involve at least some occurrence of copper in soft tissues.
plausibility_justification: Copper is present in highly-conserved metabolic systems.

label: G. morhua liver
plausibility_justification: Copper is present in highly-conserved metabolic systems, and is particularly concentrated in livers.

label: G. morhua muscle
plausibility_justification: Copper is present in highly-conserved metabolic systems.

label: Macroalgae
notes: G033-Ba-Cnr-A-nod-Sti-Mw, G147-Ba-Cnr-A-nod-Pla-Mw & G036-Ba-Cnr-F-ves-Sti-Mw, potential pollution signal but small samples

label: River water
notes: Aquatic / Freshwater, River, stream, canal, water column. Group G001-Wfw-Rwc-C: 41,831 measurements, the largest group in the dataset, geometric mean 1.52e-3 mg/L against 8.48e-4 for coastal water.

label: River sediment
notes: Aquatic / Aquatic Sediment, River, stream, canal, water benthos. Group G008-Wsd-Rwb-Md: 857 measurements, geometric mean 20.5 mg/kg dry, which is indistinguishable from coastal sediment at 20.6.

label: Catchment runoff
notes: Runoff and weathering from the copper-rich Ulveryggen-Nussir catchment to the inner fjord and Repparfjordelva. Magnitude TBD. Added 2026-08-28.
